newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz non-life unit 96 profit up 41.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Allianz non-life unit 96 profit up 41.5 pct.

text.p: Calendar 1996 (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Return on sales 14.8 pct vs 10.3 pct

NOTE - Full name of German insurer is Allianz Versicherungs AG, the domestic non-life unit of Allianz AG Holding. All figures are provisional. Allianz Versicherungs chairman Reiner Hagemann said in a speech prepared for a news conference that the profit rise was due to unusually favourable claims experience, strong new business and a marked success in streamlining of work procedures.

The decline in premium income was mainly due to a new and overall cheaper price structure in car insurance. Income had also been affected by a general trend toward price reductions, increasingly poor conditions in the German economy and consistent continuation of risk selection, particularly in industria insurance.
